newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Tomin unit sets subordinated note programme.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Tomin unit sets subordinated note programme.

text.p: Tokyo Tomin Bank Ltd announced on Monday that one of its overseas affiliates had set up a guaranteed euro subordinated note programme for subordinated bond issues of up to 70 billion yen in an attempt to improve the bank's capital base.
Under the programme, Tokyo Tomin Finance (Cayman) Ltd would be able to issue subordinated notes of over five years, as well as perpetual subordinated bonds, the company said in a statement.
Yamaichi International (Europe) Ltd was helping arrange the programme, it said.
